comments.value: One request per entry, otherwise what do I do if I like some of the ideas and not the others? I can't vote unless it's specific enough to be clear that it doesn't contain anything I don't want.

details:
Good afternoon reader, player, or developer. The following is a list, as organised as possible, of features that would best be suited for VRChat. Please take the time to peruse the ideas and if you agree, please post and comment. And if you are the developer, please consider adding these Quality Of Life, and better Business practice features.
-------------------------- User Interface ------------------- *Hotkeys and Control Bindings Currently, in its basic form, VRChat has many functions that require you to first bring up your VR Hand Menu before you can select certain actions, like emoting, emojis or even toggeling game options like Muting yourself. While it is true most users do not play with a keyboard, or gamepad, many do, and being able to map controls to the following features would be greatly welcome. Quick access to these actions would improve the quality of life for most end users. Simply default these to no keybind and allow users to set their own. - Emotes 1-8 - Emojis 1-6 - Toggle sit and stand mode - Mute/Unmute yourself (for anyone who has mic always on selected.) - Changing of the Push to talk key. - Toggle Personal Space mode - Toggle Mute all other users on and off, (for quick relief of a sound you cant find source of)
*Priority Mode For Hand Menu Currently, many game objects are drawn over the user menu, preventing them from reading or even accessing the menu unless they can move to a different area or face a different direction. Many of these cases make no sense, as the overlapping objects are in the far distance, like grass and water, yet they still draw over the menu. Having the menu take priority over all in game objects would be a greatful change. I do not know the limitation such a change would have codewise, but if a workaround can't be found, perhaps allowing a second non-3d menu that when a certain key is pressed can pop up on screen that uses analog and select/cancel keys rather than direct pointing would be a good alternative. This would allow someone, who may be trapped and can't see thier menu from having to log out and log in.
* [u]Recent Avatar List[/u] Currently, if you want to use an avatar selectable in a Avatar World in game, it overwrites any previously selected avatar. Users who have taken the long effort of uploading their own characters may not have any issues switching at will, but other users find themselves having to leave a party, gathering or conversation completely to go get a different avatar. My suggestion here is simple. Add a list below PUBLIC and PERSONAL lists of avatars that is called RECENT This list will save any avatar the player changes into, for later use. (This list would not inclide default or personal avatars, only ones selected in game.) The list will be 5 avatars long. Any new avatar added will erase the oldest one in the list.
* [u]Alternatively, or also... Favorite Avatar List[/u] Much like the RECENT list above, a favorite avatar list could save up to 5 avatars. This list would add any avatar you are currently using, having found it in an avatar room, and select or press a "FAVORITE" button in the menu. That avatar would be uploaded to the users profile much like how a personal upload is done, so that it can be loaded again by that player upon command.
* [u]Recent Worlds[/u] Simply put, saving the last 5 worlds you went to, to their own separate list would be very helpful for anyone who had to restart their game or leave an area temproarily. Favoriting wouldnt work because there are so many 'instances' of the same world out there, and a particular instance may be expunged from the system if no one is active in it for a while, but I believe a RECENT function would work well, as RECENT worlds would likely still be active. - Recent Worlds would only be cleared off the list as other newer worlds are visited. They would not clear on log out, as some game crashes may see you wanting to rejoin a world again. * [u]VR Users Distinguishable[/u] This is a simple one. If a user is using a VR set, have their nameplate be outlined Blue. Leave non-VR players as green. I don't know why its not easy to distinguish VR players sometimes, but people ask me all the time "you using VR?" when my character is super static and unmoving and I am clearly not. I suppose this would help those people and prevent the need to ask?
-------------------------- Cmmunication and Interaction ------------------ Ingame Text Messages[/u] Currently, if you step away from a group of friends, or you have just logged in and you want to see what your friends are up to without actually going to their world first to find out, it becomes difficult. This forces users to add people from VRChat to other 3rd party softwares like Discord, or Steam. Some people may not feel comfortable adding an aquaintance or even a good in game friend to their external chat devices, as that gives them access to information about you that you may not want them to have. Sometimes game friends should stay game friends. The addition of an ingame message system, where you can type a message to a friend, even if limited to 100 characters per message or something, would be super helpful. - Messages would all be cleared on logout, so no internal message system would need to become a large cache or sever space hog. - Only added friends could message you, to prevent spam. [u]Locate, Option[/u] As an alternative to the above, adding a toggle for each player that allows them others to 'LOCATE' them in a world easily, would be welcome. Simply put, if a player has the LOCATE ME toggle on, any player who wants to find them in a world can have an indicator of some kind pointing them in the direction the other player is. This would allow players to find eachother much easier. It would be toggle-able for those who wish to be left alone, of course. I understand there would be a limitation if a world has "doorways", since any doorway a player goes through would throw off the LOCATE function. I have no suggestion for a workaround to this issue except for making it a "teleport to" option instead. But then that really starts to get annoying when people pop up inside you a bunch... perhaps there is another alternative?
[u]Friend Notes[/u] On a friends INFO page, being able to add a short personal note that only you can see, would be helpful sometimes, in remembering real names they told you, or where/when you met. ETC. [u]Selfie Camera[/u] Being able to move your current camera (eyes) to the same location of your ingame Menu (facing you) with a button toggle, would be a neat feature to see. This would allow you to take screenshots (selfies) of yourself. And also see your model without the need for a mirror. The Camera would attach to your characters HAND just like the Menu does. As every character regardless of bones can pull up a menu (albiet a static non-mobile one), I would be suprised if this was not possible.
[]-------------------------- Performance -------------------[\b] [u]Character Max Draw Distance[/u] A slider that lets you change how close a person must be for their character to render would be a welcome addition. This would allow you to interact with those close to you, and not have distance players in large groups from causing you frame lag. Players would still render as the "loading" model that you see when you log into a world before models load, when at a distance, so you could still see the presence of players. No animations would load for those players far away either, which I feel would reduce server lag, since a players animations, or every action would not have to be sent to all players any longer. - Would default to max distance (so as is). - Would sometimes be able to prevent those models and animatons that blanket a whole world with light and such.
[u]Vertical Sound Distance[/u] A slider that lets you lower the distance you can hear people above or below you, would be great. Some multifloor worlds are difficult to hang out in because one or two players a floor above you sound as if they are right next to you. This would allow you to limityour vertical hearing so that only those on your immediate floor would be heard.
[]-------------------------- Business Model -------------------[\b] I understand the motivation behind this game being free to play, as it gets people to buy VR sets after playing once. Seeing other players have them really gets your mouth watering for one. But I feel like having premium features to this game (above and beyond what Is currently free that is) could help in its further developement and ability to grow. The following are ideas for such content that would be welcome and likely not frowned upon for being offered. [u]Premium Accounts[/u] Simply put, having a one time 9.99 purchase (no subscritions please) of a premium DLC would allow the following to be done by any user who does. * Name Text Color Choice * Maximum RECENT WORLD and RECENT AVATAR list size doubled (requires suggestion listed in a section above) * Being able to host Premium User Only worlds * Use of Built In Voice Changers (would have to be added of course)
[u]No Custom Avatars Toggle[/u] Allowing a user to select this and have all nearby players default to their PUBLIC model, would be cool (client side only of course). For younger users who dont wanna see all the... um, everything but still want to interact and chat. And Streamers who may want to have a clean stream for a moment while they AFK or something. - This could also be useful on a per player basis. Select a player and force their model to be defaulted. Sometimes you dont want to block someone (because you want to still talk to them), but their model is offensive. Could also help with performance issues if you make a high poly model default to a PUBLIC on with less verts.
title: Detailed list of suggestions
